title: NPDev AI configuration (providers, models, profiles, bindings)
description: ONE schema for both layers: the catalogue NPDev ships (NPDevCli/ai-providers.json) and the user's own overlay (~/.config/NPDev/ai.json, or %APPDATA%\NPDev\ai.json; NPDEV_AI_CONFIG overrides the path). An overlay entry whose id matches a shipped one overrides only the fields it sets, so only ids are required here; completeness and every cross-reference (a profile naming an unknown model, a protocol no client implements) are checked on the MERGED view by NPDevCli/npdev_ai_config.py. Neither file ever holds a secret: keys live in the OS key store (`npdev providers`).

protocols.description: The closed list of wire protocols NPDev clients implement. Shipped only: both the Python client (npdev ai complete) and the Java external-ai-http adapter must implement every entry. Adding one is an adapter per side plus tests.

spend.description: The spend guard. A paid call (kind paid, or a non-free model id on a freeModelSuffix provider) is refused unless its feature is opted in here, or a direct call passes --allow-paid. With a monthly cap, a model of unknown price is refused too, because the cap could not be enforced on it. Never shipped: the default is no paid spend, and a $10 monthly cap once a feature opts in (owner decision D2); monthlyCapUsd null means no cap.

bindings.description: Which profiles a feature uses, in failover order. An overlay binding replaces the shipped one for that feature.

kind.description: local = runs on this machine, free = hosted free tier, paid = billed. The spend guard refuses a paid call without an opt-in.

keyEnvVar.description: The NPDev convention NPDEV_EXTERNALAI_<ID>_API_KEY. null for a keyless provider.

extraHeaders.description: Fixed, non-secret headers (e.g. anthropic-version). Lower-case names; an auth header is refused here: the key is added by authStyle at call time.

queryParams.description: Fixed, non-secret query parameters (e.g. Azure's api-version). A key-like name is refused.

modelInPath.description: Deployment-style URLs: {model} in baseUrl is replaced by the model id.

defaultModel.description: A models[] id of this provider, or null when the account decides (run discovery).

freeModelSuffix.description: Only model ids ending with this are free on this endpoint; any other is billed.

appVendor.description: Generated apps' external-ai-http adapter may use it.

model.description: One model on a provider, with its facts. A fact NPDev does not know is left out (unknown), never guessed: an unknown price counts as paid.

effortLevels.description: Levels the model really accepts. Empty: no effort parameter is ever sent.

price.description: USD per million tokens. null = unknown.

enabled.description: false = known but not offered (a newly discovered model starts here).

status.description: retired = the provider's model list no longer has it (set by `npdev ai models refresh`).

discovered.description: When `npdev ai models refresh` or `npdev ai detect` first saw it (ISO date).

profile.description: A named, ready-to-use setting: provider + model + effort + limits, with optional fallback profiles.

account.description: Which stored key of the provider (D5: <provider>:<account>). Absent = the provider's default key.

temperature.description: Sent only where the protocol accepts it (never on anthropic-messages).
